newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-S.LANKA NAMES TEAM FOR SECOND TEST V INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.LANKA NAMES TEAM FOR SECOND TEST V INDIA.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Thursday named a 14-member squad for the second and last test against India starting in Colombo on Saturday.
The first test ended in a draw on Wednesay.

SRI LANKA (from): Arjuna Ranatunga (Captain), Aravinda de Silva, Sanath Jayasuriya, Mavan Atapattu, Roshan Mahanama, Chaminda Vaas, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Muttiah Muralitharan, Mahela Jayawardena, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Kumar Dharmasena, Ruwan Kalpage, Upul Chandana, Sajeeva de Silva.
